name: What defines an open-concept kitchen, and how does AKN Design Group approach its design?

mainEntity.name: What defines an open-concept kitchen, and how does AKN Design Group approach its design?

acceptedAnswer.text: An open-concept kitchen integrates the cooking, dining, and living areas into a single, cohesive space, removing traditional barriers like walls. AKN Design Group approaches this by harmonizing the design elements—such as cabinetry, flooring, and lighting—across these zones to ensure a seamless flow and aesthetic continuity. Our integrated design-build process ensures that the structural modifications, like wall removal, are carefully planned and executed with proper engineering, maintaining the structural integrity of your home while maximizing functionality and beauty. This transformation is about more than just removing walls; it's about enhancing the overall functionality and flow of your home to better suit your lifestyle.
acceptedAnswer.description: An open-concept kitchen integrates cooking, dining, and living areas. AKN Design Group harmonizes design elements and manages structural modifications for seamless flow and functionality.
